decisions.reason: Moving the branded placard to a customer-facing position does not change the established beige primary color or green accents.
The placard relocation does not alter the existing DJ-turntable-inspired visual theme.
The same message separately confirms the rendered spout approach, which is already represented in this Requirement; relocating the placard requires no additional spout-design change.
Placard position and customer-facing orientation do not change the solenoid valve or button-controlled dispensing behavior already recorded from this message.
The placard relocation has no effect on the stainless-steel food-contact material requirement.
Moving the placard does not change the dispensing path, retained-matcha constraint, pour quality, or beverage-preservation behavior.
The branded plate's position and viewing direction do not affect bowl depth, capacity, or refill policy.
Relocating the placard does not necessarily change the enclosure's size constraint or side-profile thickness.
The placard's customer-facing placement does not change the splash-control target.
The source reiterates that the spout faces the baristas, which already matches the candidate's current state and requires no modification.
The placard relocation does not affect the base support or operational-stability requirements.
The viewing orientation of the placard does not change the whisk head's size, style, powder suitability, or bowl compatibility.
